name: openviking-memory
description: Long-term semantic memory for Codex, powered by OpenViking. Recall on UserPromptSubmit, incremental add_message on Stop (per turn), commit on SessionEnd (Codex >= 0.145) and on PreCompact; the server's session policy commits by threshold and idle time. Includes a local stdio MCP proxy that reads OpenViking credentials from env/ovcli.conf.

interface.longDescription: Hooks Codex's lifecycle to keep an external semantic memory: recall relevant memories on each UserPromptSubmit; on every Stop (turn end) append the new user/assistant turns to a long-lived OpenViking session keyed by codex session_id; on SessionEnd (Codex >= 0.145) catch up any turns Stop missed and commit the session so OV's extractor produces durable memories when the thread finishes; on PreCompact commit before context is summarized. Sessions that end without a SessionEnd are committed by the server's session policy (pending-token threshold and idle time). Also exposes OpenViking's native MCP tools through a local stdio proxy to the streamable-HTTP /mcp endpoint for manual use.
capabilities: Automatic memory recall on each prompt
Session archive search and original-text read-back
Explicit MCP tools for retrieval, memory, resources, watches, filesystem, and code navigation
Per-answer OpenViking source summaries and expanded details
